summary: Hand-wrote eight reader-facing console pages following the approach-page template. Six value-policy-learning approach pages replaced generated drafts: monte-carlo-return, monte-carlo-value, phase-distillation, sibling-advantage, structured-nnue and value-model, each carrying only numbers that exist in a retained record (ledger entries for the Monte Carlo state-value and structured-NNUE experiments; explicit 'no retained result' statements where only a task-record index row exists). Rewrote the afterstate-learning family page and wrote the distributional-afterstate approach page, which renders the theory, all four preregistered experiments and the two decisive results through TheorySummary/ExperimentSummary/ResultSummary and explains in plain English what the top-two near-tie override gate tested and why 'valid run, outcome fail, with positive signal' is the honest reading. No research record, protocol or source file was modified and no experiment was run.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
